LESSON: WATER ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.4: Water ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Water ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are the uses of water?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. talk about uses of water in their home and school
2. conserve water at home and school
3. appreciate water conservation at home and school about uses of water items used to conserve water at home and at school taps after use 140 to use and re-use water properly engage in sinking,floating,filling and emptying songs, recite poems, and rhymes related to water Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. talk about uses of water in their home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about uses of water in their home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. conserve water at home and school
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to conserve water at home and school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate water conservation at home and school about uses of water items used to conserve water at home and at school taps after use 140 to use and re-use water properly engage in sinking,floating,filling and emptying songs, recite poems, and rhymes related to water Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate water conservation at home and school about uses of water items used to conserve water at home and at school taps after use 140 to use and re-use water properly engage in sinking,floating,filling and emptying songs, recite poems, and rhymes related to water Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Water ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Water ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Water ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: talk about uses of water in their home and school
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Water ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What are the uses of water?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. talk about uses of water in their home and school
2. conserve water at home and school
3. appreciate water conservation at home and school about uses of water items used to conserve water at home and at school taps after use 140 to use and re-use water properly engage in sinking,floating,filling and emptying songs, recite poems, and rhymes related to water Core-Competences to be developed:
